control_failures.control_label: mechanical support of a load during maintenance access
application of positive isolation devices and personal locks

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: fire on CV-3101 during an intrusive maintenance task

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on CV-3101 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically handing back a partially completed isolation. CV-3101 (plant conveyors) is in service for coarse ore and reclaim conveying. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 4 September 2014 an incident occurred on CV-3101 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during an intrusive maintenance task, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
